question:

HEAD : IGDH :: HAND : ICQH :: BACK : ?

[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/15d4e688c8bdc2766cb74c67a7c0d12a85a1e60bc448f376b860b7949a5ae586.png]

HEAD : IGDH

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/8ed4710b5986a73709ba344b47c20111e92fae4f9350ea8c893b5e43ccea0cfe.png] 

And,

HAND : ICQH

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/48570df872236f2bc62f4d4f3b84c8edaa23c4b2ecc2dea889e5242e28799514.png]

BACK : ?

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/d358f9a86573ce9105c69002769b38ea89f1aa353568d5f83b5daa31358d5f40.png] 

Hence, "Option 4" is the correct answer.
